Tax.why_built: Legacy/parallel tax-computation sheet (sheet11): 123 defined names (TaxPayableOnTotInc, SurchargeOnTaxPayable, EducationCess) anchor here, but it uses stale 3% cess — kept for named-range tracing only; the authoritative current-year method is Tax(N). Read, never displayed.

Part A Gen_139(8A).reason: ITR-U updated-return (section 139(8A)) Part A General — a separate return type (ITR-U), not used by the standard AY 2026-27 ITR-5 return.

PDTCAse.reason: Reference case-flag lookup table (Q1-Q4 tax-determination cases) feeding the hidden Tax computation sheet; not a fillable screen and has no schema block.

Instructions.reason: Help/instructions page for the Schedule 112A/115AD CSV import; not part of the return.

HelpCSV.reason: Help page describing how to fill Schedule 112A/115AD via CSV; not part of the return.

Tax(N).why_built: LIVE AY2026-27 tax-computation engine (sheet41): 4% health-and-education cess (matches Part B-TTI) and hosts the 234A/B/C interest outputs Part B-TTI consumes. Read to build the tax engine.

DB.reason: Master dropdown/enum database backing every (Select) list (124k rows of state/country/NOB/unit codes); a data source, not a screen — enums live in enums.json.

Part B ATI.reason: Part B-ATI computation for the ITR-U updated return (section 139(8A)); belongs to the ITR-U flow, not the standard return.

FD.reason: Schedule FD (foreign-currency payments/receipts break-up) has no schema block in ITR-5 blocks.json (no ScheduleFD) — cannot be filed; excluded per rule 3.

CG Pop up_prefill.reason: AIS prefill pop-up staging table for capital-gains property data; an import helper, not a screen.

SUMMARY.reason: Print/summary display view computed from the other sheets; no input and no schema block of its own.

Help.reason: General 'How to use this Excel Utility' help page; not part of the return.

112.reason: CSV import staging table (ISIN rows) for Schedule 112A; a data-entry helper, not a filed schedule.

115.reason: CSV import staging table (ISIN rows) for Schedule 115AD(1)(b)(iii); a data-entry helper, not a filed schedule.
